author: Sol 6.1 xhigh, hypothesis_frontier role
mode: COMMON_COMPARISON_OF_DECLARED_FROZEN_SCENARIOS; not AUTHOR_REPLAY of colleagues' economic models
question: Какие изменения продукта/календаря обходят простое увеличение спроса, и какое ограничение удерживает каждое?

tests.baseline: Frozen C01_unsync: four directed flights, two hypothetical tails starting NJC and UFA, six operating dates; not an observed existing RW allocation
tests.intervention: Retime the SOUTH rotation only, keeping its two block times, directed legs, dates, nominal seats and both tails' initial/final positions; impose explicit turn/connection limits
tests.effect: Derive the exact feasible retiming interval and earliest SOUTH return, versus the frozen sync and unsync clocks
tests.reject: No feasible times under the declared connection/turn/return limits; positive economics additionally require residual seats, paid demand and complete incremental costs
tests.resource_unit: minutes per operating date, two hypothetical tail rotations; no free aircraft claim
tests.money_rule: Delta=one through fare per new endpoint journey minus per-journey expense minus K(q); K includes retiming/base/overnight/reserve, changed local margin, other own-network effects and resource opportunity once. Identical flight costs cancel only under identical cost/contract conditions.
tests.outside_scope: Real no-new-base baseline, MCT, dispatch, slots, crew, demand, fares, budgets and new-base admission

tests.baseline: Frozen SVX-OMS-SVX reference: 205 block minutes, 255 elapsed; scenario date alignment and hypothetical common tail
tests.intervention: Insert the dated scenario OMS-KJA-OMS excursion and shift the entire four-leg chain earlier only as much as needed to satisfy an explicit return deadline
tests.effect: Find minimum departure advance for each deadline and test the earlier-start limit; show UTC/local dates and total occupied time
tests.reject: Advance allowance below required advance; chronological closure is insufficient for aircraft/crew/MRO or displaced baseline acceptance
tests.resource_unit: one complete four-leg rotation; OMS-KJA times are another carrier's proxy, not RW dispatch block
tests.money_rule: Delta=OMS-KJA local product contribution plus change on both SVX-OMS base legs, minus every new flight/ground/fixed/switching cost and other opportunity loss. Actual donor UNKNOWN. Lost donor contribution and the same lost revenue are never both deducted.
tests.outside_scope: Real donor, paid quota, slots, aircraft, crew/MRO, actual avoidability; no KEEP/REPLACE/CANCEL optimization

tests.baseline: Frozen advertised A4 KVX-MRV return calendar and two named-property booked-date assumptions, 24 request rows = 12 date/stay combinations x 2 properties
tests.intervention: Permit at most 0/1/2/3 additional booked nights to reach the earliest captured return without changing physical published flights
tests.effect: Count date-compatible combinations at each flexibility limit, preserve beyond-capture UNKNOWN and list all remaining booking gates
tests.reject: Extra nights exceed stated tolerance; a date match alone cannot pass hotel/transfer/inventory/operator/contract gates
tests.resource_unit: passenger product calendar on incumbent advertised flights; no RW seat ownership or free operating chain
tests.money_rule: Actual airline revenue and total stay cost UNKNOWN. Do not multiply PERSON_BED_DAY/PERSON_DAY tariffs by nights. RW's new four-leg chain needs a separate full-flight-cost K and positive local-base-leg contribution cannot be presumed. A4 offers are not RW revenue.
tests.outside_scope: Observed willingness to extend, hotel inventory/admission, complete transfer, airline inventory/fares, a RW operating calendar or commercial agreement

common_rules: One endpoint journey consumes one seat on every used physical leg and receives one through fare; return product counts two endpoint journeys.
Alternative strategies, policies and property variants share travelers and are never added together as new demand.
All deadline/turn/MCT/tolerance values are scenario stress points, not observed distributions, probabilities or legal limits.
Money, actual resource and market fields remain null with a reason where inputs are absent.
Preserve all negative, infeasible and unknown rows; no overall winner or launch approval.
Self-check is not independent review, source or market acceptance; do not duplicate the active mixed D+previous/general-budget task.
